LESSON PLAN CREATIVE ARTS ACTIVITIES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND: WEAVING
SUB STRAND: FORMS: Serrated Card Loom weaving
SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of the lessons, the learner should be able to:-
  Identify woven items in the physical and or digital media for motivation.
  Make a serrated card loom for weaving a table mat.
KEY INQUIRIES QUESTION
  How do we identify materials used in serrated card loom weaving?
  How do we prepare a serrated card loom?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Communication and collaboration  Respect Self-esteem
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Self-awareness
  Problem solving skills  responsibility
 Health and hygiene
  Digital literacy
  Learning to learn
Learning Resources
Sample serrated card loom, sample woven items, and stiff papers such as carton box,
manila paper ,ruler ,woven articles such as table mat ,floor mat /rag or cloths ,cutting tools such
as safety scissors ICT devices.
KLB Visionary art and craft Grade 2 Teachers Guide pg. 83-89.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pair/groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT
Step 1: Display to learner’s sample of serrated card loom.
Step 2: Guide learners to observe and identify serrated card loom, materials used in weaving.
Step 3: Demonstrate and guide learners how to make a serrated card loom.
Step 4: Learners to store safely the card loom made for the next lesson.
SUMMARY
Weaving is the process of interlacing or intertwining two sets of thread known as warp and weft.
CONCLUSION
Learners to display their work and talk about others work.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to make decorative woven items such as coasters through the guidance of parents.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

STRAND: WEAVING

SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of the lessons, the learner should be able to:-
  Identify woven items and weaving materials in the physical and or digital media for motivation.
  Fix wrap on a serrated card loom for weaving.
  Weave a two color table mat for self-expression.
KEY INQUIRIES QUESTION
  How do we fix thread on a serrated card loom?
  How do you weave the second line when making table mat?
  How do we weave using a serrated card loom?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Communication and collaboration  Respect Self-esteem
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Self-awareness
  Problem solving skills  responsibility
 Health and hygiene
  Digital literacy
  Learning to learn
Learning Resources
Woven articles, ICT devices, serrated card looms, cutting tools,
Raffia, banana fibers, reeds, grass strips of fabric, or t shirt materials, thread, stings.
KLB Visionary art and craft Grade 2 Teachers Guide pg. 83-89.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pair/groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT
Step 1: Display to learner’s sample of serrated card loom.
Step 2: Guide learners to identify woven articles and weaving materials.
Step 3: Demonstrate and guide learners how to fix the warp on a serrated card loom and how to weave.
Step 4: Guide learners to fix the warp thread and weave at least 5 lines.
SUMMARY
Weaving is the process of interlacing or intertwining two sets of thread known as warp and weft.
CONCLUSION
Learners to display their work and talk about others work.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to make decorative woven items such as coasters through the guidance of parents.

STRAND: WEAVING
SUB STRAND: FORMS: Dowel Loom Weaving: making a dowel loom
SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of the lessons, the learner should be able to:-
  Identify woven items in the physical and or digital media for motivation.
  Identify tools and materials for weaving using a dowel.
  Make a dowel loom for weaving a table mat.
KEY INQUIRIES QUESTION
  Which materials from the local environment that can be to make a dowel?
  How do we make a dowel loom?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Communication and collaboration  Respect Self-esteem
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Self-awareness
  Problem solving skills  responsibility
 Health and hygiene
  Digital literacy
  Learning to learn
Learning Resources
Woven articles, dowel loom, sticks, banana fiber, reeds, rope,
Strings, strips of fabric, cutting tools, ICT devices, sticks.
KLB Visionary art and craft Grade 2 Teachers Guide pg. 90-95
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pair/groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT
Step 1: Display to learner’s sample of woven items from teacher’s collection and or digital media.
Step 2: Guide learners to identify and name materials for making a dowel loom and for weaving.
Step 3: Demonstrate and guide learners how to make a dowel loom.
Step 4: Learners to individually make dowel looms and store them for the next lesson.
SUMMARY
Weaving is the process of interlacing or intertwining two sets of thread known as warp and weft.
CONCLUSION
Learners to display their work and talk about others work.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to make decorative woven table mats that can be used at home.
